lessons.has_h5p: Flag indicating that the lesson carries at least one embedded H5P interactive object.

h5p_contents.lesson_id: Foreign key referencing the lesson the interactive object is embedded in.
h5p_contents.title: Display title shown above the embedded object.
h5p_contents.embed_url: URL of the externally hosted H5P object, rendered inside a sandboxed frame.
h5p_contents.source_url: Canonical page for the object on its host, retained for attribution and re-editing.
h5p_contents.description: Optional explanatory text shown to the learner before the object loads.
h5p_contents.width: CSS width applied to the embed frame, defaults to full container width.
h5p_contents.height: CSS height applied to the embed frame.
h5p_contents.sequence_order: Position of this object among the lesson's embedded objects.
h5p_contents.created_at: Timestamp when the record was created.
h5p_contents.thumbnail_url: Optional preview image shown before the object is loaded.

h5p_responses.user_id: Foreign key referencing the learner who produced the response.
h5p_responses.h5p_content_id: Foreign key referencing the embedded object the response belongs to.
h5p_responses.score: Score reported by the object, where the object reports one.
h5p_responses.max_score: Maximum attainable score reported by the object.
h5p_responses.completed: Whether the object reported the interaction as completed.
h5p_responses.raw_statement: The unmodified statement emitted by the object, retained so that the record can be re-interpreted without replaying the interaction.
h5p_responses.created_at: Timestamp when the response was recorded.

lesson_ai_summaries.lesson_id: Foreign key referencing the lesson the summary describes.
lesson_ai_summaries.summary: Cached plain-language summary of the lesson, generated on first request and reused thereafter.
lesson_ai_summaries.suggested_questions: Generated prompts offered to the learner as starting points for the lesson assistant.
lesson_ai_summaries.source_content_hash: Digest of the lesson content the summary was generated from, so a change to the lesson invalidates the cache rather than serving a stale summary.
lesson_ai_summaries.model: Identifier of the generative model that produced the summary, recorded so that output can be attributed and regenerated deliberately.
lesson_ai_summaries.created_at: Timestamp when the summary was first generated.
